question: Which of the following is a tributary of Damodar river?
solution:
The correct answer is __Barakar__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Barakar River is the main tributary of the Damodar River in eastern India.
 
• Originating near the Padma in Hazaribagh district of Jharkhand it flows for 225 kilometers (140 mi) across the northern part of the Chota Nagpur Plateau, mostly in a west to east direction, before joining the Damodar near Dishergarh in Asansol, Bardhaman district of West Bengal.
 
• It has a catchment area of 6,159 square kilometers (2,378 sq mi). The main tributaries, Barsotti and Usri, flow in from the south and north respectively. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
